dcterms:description: The HYPO dataset is an annotated collection of hyperbole consisting of manually composed hyperbole and hyperbole sourced from various online sources including click-bait headlines, love letters, advertisements, and animated cartoons. It includes 709 hyperbolic utterances, along with their literal paraphrases and non-hyperbolic counterparts.
dcterms:title: HYPO Dataset

dcterms:description: A suite of synthetic test sentences generated to probe the ability of models to detect hyperbole, targeting three types of hyperbole: Extreme Case Formulations, Qualitative Hyperbole, and Quantitative Hyperbole.
dcterms:title: HyperProbe
